independence: Direct inspection of own original, frozen target, GLOBAL style and actual enabled untouched native collection before editor proposals or other-object aesthetic conclusions.
originalObservations: Nine separated blue and violet faceted chunks form an outward scattered burst around a large transparent center. Their simple triangular surfaces read as hard low-poly pebbles, with abrupt dark lower facets and relatively little softly rounded edge treatment.
The sparse layout communicates moving debris, rather than a solid reef block or a floor tile. Each piece needs readable volume; the arrangement and motion do more work than dense surface decoration.

Enabled native source confirms nine twelve-vertex/twenty-face solids, no modifiers or shape keys, no armature, no support mesh and no sockets. Object-transform actions supply the burst and recovery shrink. Weak part topology/count is not a design lock.
targetObservations: The target keeps the blue/violet fragment identity and open burst composition while making each chunk more substantial and irregularly rounded. Larger readable facets have smoother highlight transitions and warm cream/yellow accents on bright edges.

Smaller satellite chips reinforce the breaking-apart role. They are useful optional design guidance; nine original main pieces or exact satellite counts are not required independently of the functional motion contract.

Fine luminous facet seams and saturated edge speckle in the target should not be copied as halos. Target placement, silhouette extents and canvas size are aesthetic guidance, not registration measurements.
globalStyleInterpretation: Saturated clean color, solid dimensional forms, softened transitions, restrained warm high highlights and convincing lower-volume shading. Preserve blue/purple palette rather than borrowing the plant's green/orange identity.
priorityOutcomes: Give the moving chunks a coherent crafted, softly lit volume with a richer main-plane hierarchy and softened edges.
Keep blue and violet families distinct, with controlled warm highlight accents and readable lower faces instead of black patches.
Keep all burst states readable at registered logical and phone sizes, with clean transparent edges and a purposeful shrink-out terminal.
technicalStatus: Enabled native replay and current-consumer evidence in progress. Root reconciles measured motion/envelope and stale generic brief text before editor construction.
